recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶部分核型圖，顯示第 9 與第 22 號染色體對：箭頭指出的第 9 號較正常同源染色體長（der(9)），第 22 號則有一條明顯變短（費城染色體 Philadelphia chromosome），代表 t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)，是 CML 的標誌。
features: Partial G-banded karyotype showing chromosome 9 and chromosome 22 pairs
Arrowed chromosome 9 longer than its normal homolog due to gained material on 9q (der(9))
Arrowed chromosome 22 shortened, representing the Philadelphia chromosome der(22)
Pattern indicates a reciprocal translocation t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)
describe_en: Partial G-banded karyotype shows the chromosome 9 and 22 pairs. One chromosome 9, indicated by the arrow, is longer than its homolog because of material translocated from 22q, and one chromosome 22 is shortened, representing the Philadelphia chromosome. These findings indicate the reciprocal translocation t(9;22)(q34.1;q11.2), which generates the BCR::ABL1 fusion gene. In the appropriate clinical setting, this is diagnostic of chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive; the same translocation can also occur in B-lymphoblastic leukemia and rarely in AML.
